definitions.gloss: to defeat; to beat; to overcome
definitions.explanation: To win decisively against an opponent in a competition, battle, or contest. Emphasizes a clear, forceful victory.

examples.japanese: {強豪|きょうごう}チームを{打|う}ち{負|ま}かした。
{相手|あいて}を{打|う}ち{負|ま}かして{決勝|けっしょう}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: They beat their opponent and advanced to the finals.

examples.japanese: ライバル{企業|きぎょう}を{打|う}ち{負|ま}かして{市場|しじょう}シェアを{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: They beat the rival company and captured market share.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Godan verb ({打|う}ち{負|ま}かす → {打|う}ち{負|ま}かさない → {打|う}ち{負|ま}かして). Transitive: takes を to mark the defeated party.

USAGE:
The {打|う}ち〜 prefix adds emphasis and forcefulness, similar to English "beat soundly" or "trounce." Stronger than {勝|か}つ (to win) and implies a more decisive victory.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}つ: to win (neutral)
- {負|ま}かす: to defeat (less emphatic)
- {倒|たお}す: to defeat, to bring down (also emphatic)
